bullets: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: add static manifest lint that FAILs on UWP-only <Extensions> (windows.dialProtocol etc.) that cannot register for a packaged WinUI 3 desktop app and abort launch

Test-AppLaunch.ps1: classify manifest-registration failures (AppxManifest.xml / 0x80073CF6 / 'extension not supported') as a defect, not a benign environment WARN, so the validator no longer false-PASSes a non-registering app
MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: correct the 'carry over <uap:Extension>' guidance and add a manifest-checklist step to strip unsupported UWP extensions before first launch (new #manifest anchor)
